summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: The AOT Growth and Innovation ETF (AOTG) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in total market equity. The fund actively invests in a growth portfolio of low marginal cost companies in the US. Stocks are selected based on proprietary fundamental research and criteria. AOTG was launched on Jun 29, 2022 and is issued by Alpha Architect.

holdings.infoBox: AOTG is an equity ETF with a total of 43 individual holdings. The top holdings are Advanced Micro Devices stock at 15.47%, Micron Technology at 11.25%, NVIDIA at 11.03%, Alphabet at 6.90%, and Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Company at 5.09%.
